# PTBA.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v3) with a 12-month target of Rp5,112.0 against Rp3,060.0 (expected total return 80.0%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: dividend_income_anchor · method card: per fund record routing for Coal producers.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The 25% EV/EBITDA anchor is 5.497x applied to FY2025A EBITDA of 5,222.175 (fund record methods.ev_ebitda.metric), giving 3,675/share, 28.4% below the DCF and the single largest drag between the 5,136 DCF and the 4,506 ble
- The DCF bridge adds Rp10,713.4bn of equity-accounted investments at book (S6 p.7, 30 June 2026) - Rp930/share and about 18.6% of the 4,989 target - and no sentence says what the assets are, gives a Note 9 breakdown, or t
- The DCF stops at FY2057E, not at the reserve life. At 49.5 Mt the 2,883 Mt base runs to about FY2084E, so roughly 27 years of reserves are unvalued. The engine truncates at maximum cumulative value because the deck US$70

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
